$comment: Golden fixture for the §5.6 process expectation shape (Phase 9 / M5-0), stored in stac_higher.process_sources.expectation — PER SOURCE, not per process (I-63, decided in the design spec §8: different sources carry different cron cadences and arrival profiles, and the source id takes the association position in the ADR 0010 dedup key). Mirrors ingest-expectation.json field-for-field with its own key. Consumed by app/src/__tests__/contract-fixtures.test.ts (processExpectationSchema) and services/pipeline/tests/test_contract_fixtures.py (parse_process_expectation). A breach raises `process_stalled` (spec §8); no expectation means no alerting, since a quiet source may be entirely normal.

cases.name: fractional seconds (writer requires an int; reader truncates)
an association expectation key on a process source
empty object (a declared expectation must declare a window)
